ns2:course.label: Grad Bioinformatics Seminar
ns2:course.description: This seminar series focuses on research in the field of bioinformatics and computational biology. Same as ANSC 591 and CPSC 591. 0 to 2 graduate hours. No professional credit. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 4 hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
